description: This PHP class 'TimesheetPeriodService' provides methods to manage and retrieve timesheet period configurations, including fetching the defined period, start date, heading, and setting the period. It interfaces with configuration services and utilizes a factory for creating timesheet period objects.

classes.name: TimesheetPeriodService
classes.description: Service class to manage and retrieve timesheet period configurations, including start date, heading, and period validation.

methods.name: getDefinedTimesheetPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the dates for the current timesheet period based on configuration and current date.

methods.name: getDaysOfTheTimesheetPeriod
methods.description: Calculates and returns days within the timesheet period, given an XML configuration and a current date.

methods.name: isTimesheetPeriodDefined
methods.description: Checks if the timesheet period is currently defined in the configuration.

methods.name: setTimesheetPeriod
methods.description: Sets and saves a new timesheet period starting from the specified start day.

methods.name: getTimesheetHeading
methods.description: Retrieves the heading/title of the current timesheet period.

methods.name: getTimesheetStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the timesheet period as a string.
